mechanisms.title: Relation contract profile
mechanisms.semantics: Report variable, scope, row and isolated-variable counts.
mechanisms.acceptance: Direct set inventory with independently computed incidence counts.

mechanisms.title: Global satisfying assignments
mechanisms.semantics: Return every complete binary assignment satisfying every relation.
mechanisms.acceptance: Indexed tuple join versus exhaustive complete assignments; frozen solution count.

mechanisms.title: Pairwise projection consistency
mechanisms.semantics: Compare each pair of relation projections on the full shared scope.
mechanisms.acceptance: Projection sets versus explicit existential support of each local tuple.

mechanisms.title: Directed semijoin supports
mechanisms.semantics: For every ordered distinct relation pair, retain supported left tuples.
mechanisms.acceptance: Indexed shared-key membership versus nested compatible tuple search.

mechanisms.title: Semijoin fixed point
mechanisms.semantics: Iterate semijoins to a finite descending fixed point with a removal trace.
mechanisms.acceptance: Asynchronous indexed reduction versus synchronous brute support rounds.

mechanisms.title: Globally supported tuples
mechanisms.semantics: Project the full solution set onto each relation scope.
mechanisms.acceptance: Joined projections versus exhaustive completion of each local tuple.

mechanisms.title: Dangling tuple certificates
mechanisms.semantics: List each local tuple without a global completion.
mechanisms.acceptance: Local-minus-global support versus universal rejection of all extending assignments.

mechanisms.title: Local and global consistency distinction
mechanisms.semantics: Distinguish nonempty join, pairwise consistency, fixed point and exact global consistency.
mechanisms.acceptance: Every relation must equal its full-join projection; nonempty alone is insufficient.

mechanisms.title: Join order invariance
mechanisms.semantics: Compare complete results across all relation permutations within the five-relation cap.
mechanisms.acceptance: Permuted indexed joins versus one independent exhaustive truth set.

mechanisms.title: Tuple provenance certificates
mechanisms.semantics: For each global assignment list the supporting original relation-row identifiers.
mechanisms.acceptance: Explicit row membership in every relation with no identity or authority conversion.

mechanisms.title: Variable elimination count
mechanisms.semantics: Count satisfying assignments by integer factor elimination.
mechanisms.acceptance: Sum-product elimination versus exhaustive Boolean assignments, including isolated variables.

mechanisms.title: Minimal inconsistent relation sets
mechanisms.semantics: Enumerate all inclusion-minimal relation subsets with no solution.
mechanisms.acceptance: Recursive deletion search versus exhaustive subsets and proper-subset checks.

mechanisms.title: Minimal relation deletion repairs
mechanisms.semantics: Enumerate all minimal relation deletions restoring a nonempty solution set.
mechanisms.acceptance: Minimal hitting sets of conflicts versus exhaustive satisfiable complements.

mechanisms.title: Relation redundancy witnesses
mechanisms.semantics: Identify which individual relation removals leave the full assignment set unchanged.
mechanisms.acceptance: Join without a relation versus exhaustive implication counterexamples.

mechanisms.title: Pinned solution counts
mechanisms.semantics: Count solutions under every single-variable binary pin.
mechanisms.acceptance: Constraint extension and joining versus filtering independent complete assignments.

mechanisms.title: Minimum synthetic assignment cost
mechanisms.semantics: Return the minimum declared integer cost and every minimizing solution.
mechanisms.acceptance: Dynamic min-sum factors versus exhaustive integer costs; no monetary interpretation.

mechanisms.title: Declared join-tree reduction
mechanisms.semantics: Run upward and downward semijoins only for a valid declared running-intersection tree.
mechanisms.acceptance: Tree reduction equals exhaustive global supports when a valid tree is supplied. Absence of a tree declaration makes no nonexistence claim.

mechanisms.title: Trinity representation boundary
mechanisms.semantics: Represent formal compatibility analogies for the three pillars without external promotion.
mechanisms.acceptance: Explicit synthetic labels and zero empirical, participant and identity evidence.

mechanisms.title: External consistency evidence gap
mechanisms.semantics: Retain missing real observations, independent replication and governed operational evaluation.
mechanisms.acceptance: Gap remains open regardless of the finite consistency result.

mechanisms.title: Relational decision authority gate
mechanisms.semantics: Hold real allocation, identity, participant, legal, cultural and production decisions.
mechanisms.acceptance: No synthetic certificate supplies consent, competent authority or Stage 20 approval.
